name: piqeras-rules-tests
description: Firestore + Storage security rules tests for Piqeras. Runs entirely against the local emulator; no Firebase project or billing required.

scripts.test: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-piqeras --only firestore,storage "node --test firebase-rules-tests/firestore.test.mjs firebase-rules-tests/query.test.mjs firebase-rules-tests/auth-provider.test.mjs firebase-rules-tests/history.test.mjs"
scripts.test:firestore: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-piqeras --only firestore "node --test firebase-rules-tests/firestore.test.mjs firebase-rules-tests/query.test.mjs firebase-rules-tests/auth-provider.test.mjs firebase-rules-tests/history.test.mjs"
